summary: Flat start of a quiet street, but apartments 15-18 m away on both sides.
reasons: Apartments 15 m and 18 m close by
Homes all round, no parking convention

best_section.where: North kerb at the west end, under trees by the apartment block

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 15 m (same side) and 18 m (opposite); a house 9 m away begins at 30 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow street with one car parked on the kerb; a van would fit where the road is shaded by trees.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street leading to a small junction.
drivers.convention: No signs; a few cars parked nearby, no clear parking convention.

flags: Low-lying: minimum elevation 3.8 m, flood-prone possible
Dwellings 8-9 m from the kerb beyond 15 m
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shades the section, mainly from the south and east.
